intent: 魔法传送门：悬浮的发光圆环缓缓旋转，边缘散出粒子光尘

iterations.critique: A clearly readable, bright lavender-blue annular portal is centered on a very dark background. Fine violet particle dust visibly clusters and emits around the full outer rim. Between t1 and t4 the dust distribution changes substantially around the circumference, providing clear animated/rotational motion evidence while the ring remains clean and stable. The glow and palette feel mystical and suitably luminous.
